title: Grade Score Scale
description: Reference definition of the 0.0–1.0 grader score scale. Not a standalone schema — referenced by grader-receipt.schema.json.

default.meaning: Meets all criteria. Adversary concerns are minor or within acceptable scope.
Meets most criteria. One or two addressable gaps.
default.typical_verdict: ACCEPT (or REVISE if Adversary concerns are within scope)

default.meaning: Meets core criteria but has meaningful gaps that reduce usefulness.
Fails to meet key criteria. Significant revision required or human judgment needed.

description_note: Score thresholds are guidelines. Verdict is the primary output — see rules/verdict-matrix.md. A score in the ACCEPT range can still produce REVISE if Adversary raised an unaddressed within-scope concern.
